name: Cloudflare Vectorize Free
free_limit: Workers Free includes 30 million queried vector dimensions/month and 5 million stored vector dimensions; up to 100 indexes
watch_out: Usage is counted in vector dimensions, not simple query count. Free supports up to 1,536 dimensions/vector, 1,000 namespaces/index and 10 KiB metadata/vector; Workers compute and any external embeddings API have separate quotas or costs.
